\begin{document}
We regularise the Casimir energy of the oscillator chain with $\zeta(s)$, the spectral zeta function
of the oscillator, $\zeta(s)=\sum_{n\ge 0}(n+\tfrac12)^{-s}$ (units $\hbar\omega=1$).
Its values at even integers follow from the Bernoulli numbers,
\begin{equation}
\zeta(2) = \frac{\pi^2}{2} ,
\label{eq:z2}
\end{equation}
and the regularised zero-point sum is
\begin{equation}
\zeta(-1) = \frac{1}{24} .
\label{eq:zm1}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
